$comment: Equipment reference, rendered by rushroyale.js on items.html. Two kinds of entry share the page: 'Equipment' is a thing you slot onto a hero, 'Stat' is a line of text you will read on one of those things and need to understand. Only the Amulet's behaviour was confirmed from a public source; the rest of the equipment roster still needs filling in from the game's own inventory screen, which is why the equipment entries are stubs. Fields as in resources.json.

entries.name: Amulet
entries.summary: Enhances random tiles on the battlefield, so some of the squares your units land on are worth more than others.
facts: Improves random tiles on your board. Because the tiles are random, it raises your average rather than giving you something to plan around.
Crafted from 200 amulet fragments plus gold, then upgraded from there.

entries.name: Other equipment slots
entries.summary: A hero unlocks between two and four slots as it levels. What sits in each slot is a separate craft, with its own fragments.
facts: Each slot takes one item. More hero levels means more slots, up to four, so hero levelling raises your ceiling twice over — once through the hero, once through the extra item.
Same recipe every time: 200 fragments of that slot's type, plus gold.

entries.name: Item rarity
entries.summary: Items have the same four tiers as cards, and rarity does more here than it does on cards — it adds power aimed at specific factions.
facts: A rarer version of the same item is straightforwardly stronger, and adds bonuses that apply to particular factions in the game rather than to everything.
Two items with the same name are not the same item. Check the rarity before comparing them.

entries.name: Damage
entries.summary: The most direct line you will see on an item: your units simply hit harder.
facts: Raises the damage your units deal.
Everyone, which is exactly why it is rarely the interesting choice. A more specific stat often does more for a deck built around it.

entries.name: Mana from kills
entries.summary: More mana every time something dies, which means more summons and more merges over a match.
facts: Increases the mana you gain for killing enemies.
Decks that want a full board fast, and anyone who keeps running out of mana in the middle waves rather than the late ones.

entries.name: Critical damage
entries.summary: How much harder a critical hit lands. Worth noting this also grows on its own as your heroes level.
facts: Raises the damage of critical hits.
A crit-based carry. Your account's critical damage also rises with every 4th hero level, independently of any item.

entries.name: Attack speed
entries.summary: How often your units attack rather than how hard.
facts: Carries that hit lightly and often, and anything that ramps up the longer it keeps firing.

entries.name: Faction bonuses
entries.summary: Power aimed at one group of units rather than all of them. This is where item choice starts depending on your deck.
facts: Adds extra power that applies only to a specific faction, and comes in with higher item rarities.
Only the decks whose units are actually in that faction — a faction bonus you have no units for is a dead stat line.
